feeds.title: Artpiq Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest from the art world, collector news, artist stories, investment tips, and opportunities. ARTPIQ helps upcoming artists to kick­start their career by connecting them to potential investors and collectors from all over the world.

feeds.title: Berlin Art Link
feeds.description: Based on our rotating bi-monthly topics, we present exhibition reviews, artist interviews, and profiles about some of the most intriguing art and artists today.

feeds.title: ART@Berlin
feeds.description: Get a deeper look into the artist scene of Berlin and most important exhibitions. Art@Berlin wants to inform all art-lovers about the work of Berliner galleries, artists, culture institutes, and museums.

feeds.title: We And The Color » Art
feeds.description: For all who want to know the latest news from the world of art, this is the category that keeps you up to date! We feature talented artists from all over the world and provide you with information on current and forthcoming exhibitions. Whether timeless masterpieces or modern art, we show you the very best from different artistic fields.

feeds.title: Urban Nation
feeds.description: URBAN NATION and the URBAN NATION Museum is an initiative of the non-profit foundation Berliner Leben, which was founded by Gewobag AG. The work of URBAN NATION is intended to promote creative exchange between artists and Berliners, and to support integration and participation through cultural education programs in Berlin's neighborhoods.

feeds.title: Contemporary And
feeds.description: Contemporary And (C&) is a dynamic space for the reflection on and linking together of ideas, discourse, and information on contemporary art practice from diverse African perspectives.

feeds.title: Art Aurea Blog
feeds.description: Articles between the poles of design and art. Portraits of artists, designers and manufactories. Reports about important exhibitions, fairs, and auctions. Art Aurea is an international magazine for contemporary applied arts, arts, design, and authentic people.

feeds.title: mus.er.me.ku
feeds.description: The online magazine mus.er.me.ku has been publishing news from the art and culture sector with a focus on museums and exhibitions since 2013.

feeds.title: Claudine liebt Kunst » Kunstblog-Beiträge
feeds.description: Claudine liebt Kunst is the art blog for art lovers! Exhibition reports, artist portraits, events & art locations - as well as interesting facts for artists & art enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Astrid Stoeppel
feeds.description: Professional contemporary artist born and based in Germany with a passion for bright pure colors and common geometric shapes. Read more about her artworks which are displayed worldwide in various countries.

feeds.title: Artblog Cologne
feeds.description: A selection of the current art scene in Cologne and the surrounding area. Reviews, portraits, essays and more on art.

feeds.title: Kunstblog-Mannheim.de
feeds.description: Exhibitions in Mannheim and the surrounding area. We just want to report on art and artists from our region who are noteworthy.

feeds.title: Sabrina Tesch Art Blog
feeds.description: I am an art historian and art lover out of passion and have almost always been. I write the artistic texts in order to accompany, convey, describe, inspire, and to be able to immerse myself in the world of art.

feeds.title: Kunstleben Berlin » Kunst
feeds.description: A magazine for art in Berlin. If you are interested in culture at a high level and want to experience the Berlin art scene up close and away from all clichés, this is the right place for you.

feeds.title: Kunstplaza Blog
feeds.description: Kunstplaza is a modern online platform for artists, art dealers and those interested in art. Marketplace, blog, community and webshop with lots of features.

feeds.title: IGNANT » Art
feeds.description: An award-winning magazine exploring contemporary aesthetics from a different perspective.

feeds.title: Kunstundhelden
feeds.description: Kunstundhelden was founded in 2014 by Anne Zdunek in Berlin with the aim of advising protagonists and institutions in the art and culture industry and supporting them through strategic communication.

feeds.title: Galerie Vollherzig Blog
feeds.description: Art blog where art meets philosophy. Art blog for thinking, rethinking, thinking ahead. Vollherzig is a young, independent publisher for ART and PHILOSOPHY.

feeds.title: SciHi » Art
feeds.description: The SciHi Blog is a daily blog on science, technology & arts in history.
